```{=html}
<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{TreeSearch}{$x,k$}
\If{$x=\NIL$ \textbf{or} $k=x.key$}\State\Return $x$\EndIf
\If{$k&lt;x.key$}\State\Return \Call{TreeSearch}{$x.left,k$}\EndIf
\State\Return \Call{TreeSearch}{$x.right,k$}
\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
```
